title.narrative: Increased engagement of selected Asian and Pacific inter-governmental mechanisms on human rights issues, in collaboration with NHRIs

description.narrative: The Action aims to enhance the effectiveness and engagement of inter-governmental mechanisms in South-East Asia and the Pacific to address key human rights issues. This will be achieved through increasing the capacity of NHRIs to engage with the inter-governmental mechanisms in those sub-regions and by providing opportunities for that engagement to take place and become entrenched beyond the life of the Action. The Action will be implemented within the countries of APF member NHRIs, including prospective members.The project team lead will be based in Sydney, Australia the location of the APF secretariat.South-East Asia: Indonesia, Malaysia, Myanmar, Philippines, Thailand and Timor-LestePacific: Australia, Fiji, New Zealand, Samoa and Tuvalu
